items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: So she'd come in to sit in, sing a number like "A Tisket, A Tasket," which made her famous, you know, and other numbers she'd sing...

ctx.x: She must have been very young then.

Yeah, she was. She was at the Savoy with Chick Webb. Right across the street on the next corner is where the Savoy was. So she'd come in to sit in, sing a number like "A Tisket, A Tasket," which made her famous, you know, and other numbers she'd sing...

Big Joe Turner, the Blues singer, he used to sit in. I think he'd come there to New York with Count Basie. The whole band stopped at the Woodside Hotel, right next to the Victoria Cafe. Count Basie come in town with Big Joe Turner, they called him. He was a Blues singer with Count Basie's band.
